title: Source collection
description: data/sources.json: free source texts with verified URLs.

access.description: private-copy = the owner's own file, not publicly available (link works only for the owner).

superseded_for_links_by.description: Another source now used for all links to this text; this entry is kept only for provenance.

series_parent.description: Source id this document belongs under. The chronologies page nests these as a sub-list of the parent.

series_label.description: Label for a series header when it differs from title. The OSF Preprint section uses this.

preprint_url.description: Preprint page for the same paper, when url is the project page. Shown as a second link on the series line.

platform.description: Where this CFAH list entry is published. arj = Answers Research Journal. osf = the OSF project.

role.description: series = a platform section header. paper = a CFAH article. response = a comment, reply, or response. copy = a duplicate, alternate, archived, older, or PDF copy of parent.

copy_kind.description: Short tag for a copy, such as duplicate, alternate, archived, older version, or PDF.

parent.description: Series this paper or response belongs to, or the item this copy duplicates.

list_order.description: Order within the parent on the CFAH list.
